name: Builtin Cluster: Returns, Volatility & Decay Variants
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: Returns, Volatility & Decay Variants
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
open_p = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# === RETURNS VARIANTS ===
ret_log = returns(type=ReturnsType.log)(close)
ret_cum = returns(type=ReturnsType.cumulative)(close)
ret_dir = returns(type=ReturnsType.directional)(close)
ret_mon = returns(type=ReturnsType.monetary)(close)

# === FORWARD RETURNS ===
fwd_simple = forward_returns(return_type=ReturnType.simple, period=5)(close)
fwd_log = forward_returns(return_type=ReturnType.log, period=5)(close)

# === BASIC VOLATILITY ===
vol_pd = basic_volatility(type=BasicVolatilityType.price_diff, period=21)(close)
vol_rt = basic_volatility(type=BasicVolatilityType.return_type, period=21)(close)

# === DECAY / EDECAY ===
signal = close > sma(period=50)(close)
dec = decay(period=10)(signal)
edec = edecay(period=10)(signal)

# === VOLATILITY ESTIMATOR: Hodges-Tompkins ===
vol_ht = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.hodges_tompkins, period=21, trading_periods=252)(open_p, high, low, close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Returns: Log vs Cumulative vs Directional',
    category='Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Log', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Directional', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ret_log, ret_cum, ret_dir))

xy_lines(
    title='Monetary Returns',
    category='Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Monetary', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ret_mon)

xy_lines(
    title='Forward Returns (5d): Simple vs Log',
    category='Forward Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Simple', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Log', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fwd_simple, fwd_log))

xy_lines(
    title='Basic Volatility: Price Diff vs Return Type',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price Diff', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Return Type', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vol_pd, vol_rt))

xy_lines(
    title='Decay / Exponential Decay (period=10)',
    category='Decay',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Decay', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Exp Decay', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(dec, edec))

xy_lines(
    title='Hodges-Tompkins Vol (21d)',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='HT Vol', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=vol_ht)
